summary.text: Mindy Fee is a Republican state representative from Pennsylvania House District 37 who has served since December 1, 2012 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Fee previously worked as a sales executive.

paragraphs.text: Mindy Fee earned a bachelor's degree in economics from Millersville University in 1987.
Her professional experience includes working as a sales executive for TransAmerican Office Furniture, Incorporated.
In the 2023-2024 session she chaired the Liquor Control Committee and served on the Rules Committee.
